papers.title: Crossflow: Prefill-Decode Elasticity for Agentic LLM Serving
authors: Yi Xu, Ehsan K. Ardestani, Wenyin Fu, Martin Schatz, Krishna Malladi, Zhan Shu, Adnan Aziz, Shobhit Kanaujia, Ajit Mathews, Chunqiang Tang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27085v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As serving capacity demand surpasses that of training, serving efficiency becomes increasingly important. Prefill-decode (P/D) disaggregation improves serving efficiency through specialization and isolation of the two phases. These benefits rest on a static partitioning. Phase demand, however, is not static. We observe that in a large LLM fleet the ratio of uncached input to output tokens has peak-to-mean ratios up to 4.7x at minute timescales, and that in a public agentic trace the hourly ratio spans a median 24.5x within a single day, while reassigning a replica takes tens of minutes.
